purpose: Ingest and capacity-screen one positive book-to-market mechanism from the Tushare daily_basic point-in-time PB field before observing any interface row or factor return.

source_selection.why_pb_only: PB adds a daily valuation state that is absent from the accepted 44-mechanism research frontier. PE, market capitalization, turnover, volume ratio, prices, dividend yield, and provider limit status are excluded to keep one hypothesis and avoid a same-source field sweep.

mechanism_identity.economic_mechanism: Positive book value relative to market value, represented by the reciprocal of the provider's same-session price-to-book ratio.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_existing_size_proxy: Book-to-market is not free-float size. A mandatory no-return rank-correlation screen must still reject it before return access if it is a near synonym of any existing close-known factor.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_quarterly_quality: Quarterly ROE, profit, and growth remain fixed eligibility gates only. They are not added to the score or tuned as weights.

source.request_mode: one completed local trading session per call

point_in_time_policy.source_time_field: trade_date normalized to the local A-share trading session
point_in_time_policy.signal_assignment: signal-session close for a following-local-session-open entry
point_in_time_policy.residual_risk: A provider delay beyond 17:00 can make a row unavailable for the next open; every immutable snapshot retains its retrieval timestamp.

factor.name: tushare_positive_book_to_market
factor.economic_direction: lower positive PB means higher book-to-market and is frozen as better
factor.missing_or_nonpositive_pb_policy: exclude and count; never rank, clip, absolutize, offset, or impute a missing, zero, or negative PB

snapshot_contract.universe_membership: retain only instruments inside their point-in-time holding interval on trade_date; STAR, BSE, funds, bonds, and absent names are excluded and counted

required_checks_before_large_sync: the environment supplies TUSHARE_TOKEN without logging its value
the all-market response contains exactly ts_code, trade_date, and pb
the response is below the documented 6000-row ceiling
returned stock-date keys are unique and inside the fixed completed session
PB is numeric when present; missing and nonpositive PB rows are excluded and counted
the local reciprocal is finite and positive for every retained row
at least 90 percent of point-in-time buyable main-board and ChiNext names have positive PB
no credential, price, turnover, market-cap, provider limit-status, or return field appears in the snapshot or manifest
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: write a no-return rejection record and stop without a large sync, uniqueness screen, capacity audit, price access, another daily_basic field, or purchase recommendation

source_completeness_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop before uniqueness, factor capacity, or returns; do not fill missing PB, widen dates, mix a second provider, or add PE/size/turnover fields

no_return_uniqueness_policy.method: For each session, rank positive book-to-market and every existing close-known comparison factor inside the same quality/listing-eligible universe; compute Spearman correlation, then take each comparison's median daily correlation.
no_return_uniqueness_policy.comparison_scope: all existing raw technical and quarterly-quality rank fields available in the accepted market loader, including free_float_cap_proxy
no_return_uniqueness_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop without returns, inversion, PB transforms, industry neutralization, field substitution, or threshold relaxation

coverage_and_capacity_policy.quality_gate: ROE >= 5%, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY, effective only after the next local session following announcement
coverage_and_capacity_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop without reading returns, changing direction, adding ROE/PB as a tuned score, lowering coverage, or combining an old rejected factor
